title: Postgres

panels.title: Primary
panels.description: Current instance reporting that it is not in recovery.

panels.title: Inactive Replication Slots
panels.description: Inactive slots may retain WAL; retained bytes are shown in replication diagnostics.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Connections per instance and the configured max_connections limit.

panels.title: Lock-Waiting Sessions
panels.description: Sessions currently waiting on other queries.

panels.title: Longest Transaction
panels.description: Age of the longest open transaction.

panels.title: Oldest Recovery Point
panels.description: Age of the oldest recovery point reported by CNPG. This does not verify a successful restore.

panels.title: Last WAL Archive
panels.description: Time since the primary last archived WAL. Low activity can delay a new segment.

panels.title: WAL Awaiting Archive
panels.description: Largest ready-file backlog reported by either instance.

panels.title: Database Size
panels.description: Current database sizes; historical charts can include databases that have since been removed.

panels.title: Oldest Database XID Age
panels.description: Transaction-ID age of the oldest database; use with vacuum and freeze settings.

panels.title: Buffer Cache Hit Ratio
panels.description: Postgres shared-buffer hits; excludes the operating system cache. Workload and idle periods affect the ratio.

panels.title: Temporary Writes
panels.description: Bytes written to temporary files per second.

panels.title: Replication Stage Timing
panels.description: Primary-reported write, flush and replay delay for the standby.

panels.title: Checkpoints
panels.description: Timed and requested checkpoints per second.

description: Database availability, replication, backups and size. Internal diagnostics are collapsed.
